concept: How sure a claim is: a small level-2 chip with dots filled to the level in one sequential hue, and the level in words.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a confidence chip in traffic-light red, amber and green
default_to_avoid.kind: confidence chip, confidence indicator, certainty badge, evidence strength
default_to_avoid.why_not: red, amber and green read as good and bad and fail for colour-blind readers; Pane fills dots in one hue and says the level

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: an ordered magnitude steps through one hue from faint to strong, never the status colours (D-032)

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the count of filled dots carries the level so it reads without colour

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: the word beside the dots names the level in the text tone

options: A dots in one hue with a word
variants.picked: A dots in one hue with a word
variants.reason: A reads by count and word (P6). B reads as pass or fail. C gives false precision to a judgement.

root.why: the chip is a small level-2 pane with its edge so it sits on any backdrop

dots.why: the dots sit in one row with a ring-width gap

dot.why: each dot is an empty ring until the level reaches it

on.why: a reached dot fills with its step of the sequential ramp

word.why: the level in words at label size in the primary tone

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours filled dots take the text colour and empty ones keep a ring
